notes.title: VERSION 0.27.1
notes.notes:
[h2]ADDED[/h2]
[list]
[*] Official windowed mode support
[*] Screen zoom ins/outs when interacting with NPCs
[/list]

[h2]REVAMPED[/h2]
[list]
[*] Gamepad controls with the ability to hold the trigger down to auto-fire
[*] Menu font improvements (subjective, but I think it looks good)
[/list]

[h2]ALSO[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a crash involving displays with strange resolutions
[*] Fixed a scenario in which an NPC would give the player multiple keys
[*] Fixed major issues with single-stick gamepad controls
[*] Fixed minor bugs
[*] Made more minor changes
[/list]

notes.title: VERSION 0.27.0
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42583674/22d5c043b2273c0a16390128556cec7ad5db8808.jpg[/img]

[h2]ADDITIONS[/h2]
[list]
[*]  Different looking [b]Spud Patches[/b] (Checkpoints) that can be used to travel to the [b]Spud Hub[/b] for quick travel
[*]  A powerup called [b]Dash DNA[/b] and removed the "Corn Core" (these are automatically swapped for old save games)
[*]  Interactions between enemies & bosses with the beat of music
[*]  Breakable [b]walnuts[/b] that spawn daily (in-game days)
[*]  Weapon upgrade data now displays in the inventory
[*]  Player [b]damage numbers[/b]
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42583674/37cdaf43f6fbdaeecec35e8e851e9b63a4ca4cff.jpg[/img]

[h2]REVAMPS[/h2]
[list]
[*]  Changes to level design in the "Cloudy Fields" for a certain powerup
[*]  Changes to the fight with "King Corn"
[*]  Improvements to all other boss fights
[*]  New design for the peanut enemies
[*]  Tutorial system
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42583674/c9ce2e9a38401c0f247cb6c62cb0954d67114eba.jpg[/img]

[h2]ALSO[/h2]
[list]
[*]  More minor revamps & additions
[*]  Minor bug Fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Minor Changes & Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
-New larger design for the outside of "The Tower"
-Improved camera movement
-Minor level design changes

-Bug fixes:
--"Palma" was able to cancel its death animation
--The "Jump" powerup was able to get stuck in the ceiling
--Enabling "Charge" on a weapon caused unexpected weapon behavior when using a controller
--Other minor bugs

notes.title: Difficulty Balancing
notes.notes:
-Major difficulty balancing:
--New "Smart Aiming" which automatically aids in weapon aim (always enabled)
--Level design changes
--Improvements to jump controls for controllers
-New design for boss weakpoints that resembles a more memorable mushroom type
-Bosses now drop tater tots
-Slight adjustments to shop and upgrade tater tot costs
-Bug fixes

notes.title: Early Access Version Released!
notes.notes:
The day has finally come. Tater Spud has been released in Early Access! Now it's up to anyone to let me know about any horrible (or not so horrible) issues you find bug or design-wise. Please use any of the listed contacts or post something in the Community Hub.

Stay tuned because there may be announcements for new content sooner or later.
